title: Incident filing desk
description: Prepare an incident record for the archive.
intro: A new incident begins with an account. Complete the particulars, then write what happened.
formHint: These answers accompany your account. They do not need to appear again in the body.
designationHint: Use a designation someone could find in the index. Up to 256 characters.
affiliation: Which organization is filing this account?
organizationHint: CIRCA or a canonical ORG reference.
access: How should readers access this record?
sealed: Sealed — readers must acknowledge before opening
restrictedAccess: Platform-restricted access is assigned by moderation.
clearance: What clearance stamp should be printed?
clearanceHint: A cosmetic stamp; this does not grant or deny access.
warningHint: Select every warning that applies. No warnings apply confirms the listed warnings are not present; Warnings not provided leaves the decision open.
tags: How should this incident be indexed?
markdownHint: Write Markdown. Reference the registry with [[INC-00014]].
emptyPreview: Your account will appear here once you begin writing.
previewError: This draft cannot be rendered yet. Return to Editor to correct its Markdown or YAML header.
noBacklinks: This draft has no incoming references. It has not been filed.
noReferences: No references yet. Insert a registry code or write a wikilink in your account.
fixtureNote: Illustrative registry. Imports belong to this draft only.
restrictedNotice:
This character has been designated as Restricted by its creator.

You may reference this character in your filing. However, their characterization, established history, relationships, and narrative agency remain subject to CIRCA's Character Usage Guidelines.

The character's owner will be notified when your record is submitted.

If the owner believes your portrayal violates the guidelines, they may request a review. Confirmed violations may result in content moderation actions, including a content strike.
acknowledge: I understand the character usage guidelines.
temporaryHint: Temporary codes belong to this draft. Permanent references are assigned only on submission.
caption: Caption / alternative text
imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Up to 10MB per image and 50MB per draft. Saved in this browser.
imageType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
imageSize: Images must be nonempty and no larger than 10MB.
draftSize: This attachment would exceed the draft’s 50MB image limit.
captionRequired: Add a caption or alternative text.
saveError: Unsaved changes — browser storage is unavailable. Keep this page open.
restoreError: The saved draft could not be restored. Editing is available, but this session will not overwrite the saved copy.
fontError: Font changed for this session; the browser could not save your preference.
checkClear: Local checks passed. This draft remains unfiled.
submissionUnavailable: Submission is unavailable in this local preview.
warningsUnspecified: Content warnings have not been provided.
organizationRequired: Specify the filing organization and incident claimant.
missingImport: Import every referenced character and acknowledge restricted usage.
unresolved: Some entity references cannot be resolved in this draft’s registry.
missingAsset: A referenced image attachment is missing.
heading: Headings
imageMissing: Image not available in this draft
